posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
1. My favorite Hero is I can't pick a favourite!

  2. My favorite Regular Style Villain is … I don't know! Maybe Akash because it's satisfying to take down a 200HP target?

  3. My favorite Vengence Style Villain is I'll tell you when I get Villains Bugbear, because he's actually effective after playtesting.

  4. My favorite Environment is The Tomb of Anubis, a pleasing mix of horrible death traps, nasty targets and  treasure.

  5. My favorite Hero Promo is Prime Wardens Tempest, I almost always end up with a hand of cards with Tempest, this is an excellent way to "get rid of" them.

  6. My favorite Villain Promo is None particularly… I guess Omnitron because it makes them consistantly challenging.

  7. My favorite Sentinels Expansion is Vengeance, so many heroes!

  8. My favorite Character Backstory is Chrono-Ranger, the hints were laid so far back and the waiting for the reveal was worth it.

  9. My favorite Card Art is Inconceivable Obstruction, I love a surprise shark!

  10. My favorite Nemesis Matchup (A hero vs their nemesis) is Plague Rat vs Chrono-Ranger, such a short dangerous game, it's awesome.
